description: BuildNow GG is an online third-person build-and-shoot game where players place walls, floors, ramps, and roofs while switching between a pistol, machine gun, sniper rifle, shotgun, and pickaxe. Five modes support free practice, aim training, one-on-one fights, free-for-all battles, and private parties for up to six players.
intro: This guide covers the repeatable skills behind BuildNow GG: choosing useful keybinds, turning builds into cover and height, editing without losing aim, selecting the right weapon, and practicing each mechanic in the mode that isolates it best.
guideTitle: BuildNow GG Controls, Building, Aim, and Mode Guide
guideIntro: Speed matters only when every piece has a purpose. Start with reliable wall, floor, ramp, and roof placement, then combine edits and weapon swaps after the basic sequence works without hesitation.
steps: Use Aim Training on static and moving targets to learn mouse sensitivity before entering a live fight.
Practice Q for walls, C for floors, V for ramps, and Left Shift for roofs until each piece becomes automatic.
Use F to edit and apply edits, right click to reset an edit, and scroll down for a fast edit reset.
Match the weapon to the range: shotgun for close pressure, machine gun or pistol for steady fights, and sniper rifle for long sightlines.
Move from Freebuild into V-Arena, BoxFight, and Zone Wars, or host a private party when you want controlled practice with up to six players.
